newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - March 11.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - March 11.

text.p: * GenRad Inc shares broke their fall in after-hours trading Monday after the company lost almost a third of its value during regular trading hours.
GenRad closed at 12-3/4, down 5-1/2 on a day when it said first-quarter marketing expenses would be higher than expected. The stock was not moving after hours, traders said.
* U.S. high tech stocks were higher in London overnight. International Business Machines Corp was up 1/8 at 146-1/8.
Some high techs were weaker, however. Digital Equipment Corp fell 1/8 to 32 and Hewlett-Packard Co was down 1/4 at 56-1/4.
* 360 Communications Co said it expected first quarter results to be affected by higher acquisition costs, cellular fraud costs and lower operating revenues. Shares closed at 19-5/8.
* Boeing Co is negotiating with Delta Air Lines Inc to obtain an exclusive supply agreement, the Wall Street Journal reported.
Boeing closed at 105-7/8. Delta closed at 84-5/8.
